# TLI Miami — Transport Logistic International

> Freight and logistics company based in Medley, Florida, United States, serving US and international shipments with a regional focus on the Dominican Republic, the Caribbean, Central America and South America.

Official website: https://tlimiami.com. English is the primary language; Spanish pages are under /es. The published office is at 10049 NW 89th Ave, Unit 4, Medley, FL 33178, United States. Telephone: +1 (305) 887-6363. General email: info@tlimiami.com.

Freight prices, schedules, route availability and cargo handling requirements must be confirmed with the TLI team. The quote form requests an estimate; it does not book a shipment or take payment.

## Company and services

- [Company overview](https://tlimiami.com/): Introduction to TLI and its Miami logistics hub.
- [Regions and industries](https://tlimiami.com/regions): Dominican Republic, Caribbean, Central America, South America and global coverage; industries served.
- [Logistics solutions](https://tlimiami.com/logistics-solutions): Ground transportation, import/export coordination, warehousing, distribution and consolidation.
- [Air freight](https://tlimiami.com/air): Priority and consolidated air freight, sensitive cargo and shipment coordination.
- [Ocean freight](https://tlimiami.com/ocean): Full container load (FCL), less than container load (LCL), port coordination and project cargo.
- [FTL / LCL](https://tlimiami.com/ftl-lcl): Full truckload transportation and less than container load shipping. FTL and LCL describe different transport modes.

## Contact and quote requests

- [Request a quote](https://tlimiami.com/quote-now): Provide shipment details and contact information to request an estimate.
- [Contact TLI](https://tlimiami.com/contact): General inquiries and company contact information.
- [Partnership inquiries](https://tlimiami.com/contact?topic=partnerships): Contact the team about becoming an agent.
- [Career inquiries](https://tlimiami.com/contact?topic=careers): Contact the team about working with TLI.
